name: Keylogging
summary: Adversaries may log user keystrokes to intercept credentials or other information from the user as the user types them. Some methods of keylogging include: * Masquerading as a legitimate third-party keyboard to record user keystrokes. On both Android and iOS, users must explicitly authorize the use of third-party keyboard apps. Users should be advised to use extreme caution before granting this authorization when it is requested. * Abusing…
